statement: m = 2 Weil-descended S3 over F_{2^n} (pq2_rank): the iterated degree-3 closure reaches all k linear consequences for every n <= 14 and n = 16 and only 1 of them at n = 15 and on all 84 instances with 17 <= n <= 44, so the solving degree exceeds the first fall degree 2 on the 111 instances with n <= 44 (as an F4 bound under the containment property); the degree-4 closure reaches k on 33 of 33 fresh instances at n = 17..27; msolve F4 has maximal step degree 4 on all 54 main-sweep instances at n = 17..34 and on one fresh instance at n = 36 (n = 37 not finished); this window does not decide whether the degree stays bounded (Kousidis-Wiemers report 5 from n = 37).
